# Draft:The Battle of Shatrughat

----
The Battle of Shatrughat is an upcoming Hindi historical war drama film featuring Gurmeet Choudhary, Aarushi Nishank and Siddharth Nigam in lead role. The film is directed by Shahid Kazmi and is written by Sajad Khaki and Kazmi itself. The motion poster of this film was released in International Film Festival of India in Goa in 2025.
